description: Some of your most powerful insights live in the comparison — left vs. right, before vs. after, product A vs. product B. Canvas Butterfly Chart by DataFactZ turns those side-by-side comparisons into a single, symmetrical visual that is impossible to misread. Two measures, one story, zero ambiguity. The Comparison Chart Power BI Was Missing Standard bar charts force your audience to mentally subtract values across separate bars. A Butterfly Chart eliminates that cognitive load entirely — both sides radiate outward from a shared center axis, so the human eye naturally perceives magnitude and imbalance in an instant. Whether you're comparing demographics, regional sales, campaign channels, or product lines, the Butterfly Chart makes the difference visceral. Key Features - Two Chart Modes — Switch between Marketing Butterfly (absolute value comparison) and Comparative Percentage Analysis (percentage-normalized view) without rebuilding the visual. - 11 Built-In Color Themes — Standard, Warm, Cool, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Monochrome, Vibrant, Pastel, Corporate, or None. Apply a single custom color or a gradient fill with adjustable intensity. - Smooth Animations — Configurable entry animations (0–3000ms) and hover effects. Toggle off for static exports. - Flexible Data Labels — Show absolute values, percentages, or both. Independent font controls for value, category, and percentage…
